## Tokens

- Colors: original ink, cream, sand, olive, moss, ember, wine and gold palette with semantic aliases.
- Typography: Georgia/Times display; Arial/Helvetica interface; responsive display and body scales.
- Spacing: 64px, 88px and 112px section rhythm; 1180px container; 20px gutter.
- Radius: 12px controls, 20px cards/media, pill only for compact controls.
- Shadows: soft and elevated editorial shadows.

## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve Patropi's deep green, cream and gold identity.
- Preserve real photography and editorial hospitality tone.
- Use semantic tokens from `tailwind.config.ts`.

### Avoid

- SaaS visual language.
- Decorative glow and gratuitous gradients.
- Gold body text on cream backgrounds.
- Unnecessary pill shapes and heavy shadows.

## Decisions

- Consolidate the existing palette into semantic aliases without changing brand colors.
- Keep the current display and interface font families.
- Use three primary radii and two restrained elevation levels.
- Use contextual hero scales: 44–80px for primary editorial heroes and 42–72px for compact internal heroes.
- Keep one visually dominant hero action and give auxiliary route links lower emphasis.
- Present small review sets statically, using an editorial hierarchy instead of infinite marquee motion.
- Prefer divider-based lists for simple information; reserve filled containers for primary actions.
- Keep the custom gallery lightbox, with complete dialog semantics, contained focus, restored focus, inert background content and reliable scroll locking.
- Keep motion restrained and editorial; disable autoplay and nonessential transforms when reduced motion is requested.
